fields.headline: SINGLES.
fields.body: 1 against 1. The session to send out when the Cup has to be settled rather than built.

fields.headline:
ONE BALL
EACH.
fields.body: Every player plays their own ball against 1 opponent. Nothing is shared and there is nowhere to hide.

fields.headline: 100% EACH.
fields.body: Full allowance, shots off the difference. A 12 against an 18 takes 6 shots, on stroke indexes 1 to 6 and nowhere else.

fields.headline:
1 POINT, OR
EVERY HOLE.
fields.body: The event decides how a match pays, once, for the whole Cup. Match play: the match is worth 1 point and can close out 3&2. Every hole counts: each hole is a point of its own and the match runs to the last green.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
